name: Book Inventory
summary: At Northshire Abbey, Brother Paxton needs help finding missing books. He sends young adventurers to Daniel, his daydreaming assistant, to count the library's archives. But Daniel's thoughts turn to local tradeskills, making a clear answer hard to get.

sections.title: A Librarian's Frustration
sections.body: Northshire Abbey keeps scholarly works, spiritual writings, and records of Stormwind's history that survived the First War. Brother Paxton, a careful monk, takes pride in the collection. Now books are missing from the shelves, and he needs a clear count to learn how many are gone. He has little patience for chasing his daydreaming helper.

sections.title: Daniel's Straying Interests
sections.body: Daniel assists Brother Paxton in the abbey library, but his thoughts stray from parchment and catalog numbers. He is fascinated by the practical trades and professions of Elwynn Forest, including smithing, leatherworking, tailoring, and herbal craft. So when Paxton asks him to count the books, Daniel rambles about local crafters instead of looking for lost scriptures.

faq.answer: Brother Paxton is a monk of Northshire Abbey who tends its extensive collection of books, scriptures, and historical scrolls. He takes pride in the collection and quickly loses his temper when books go missing or his helpers neglect their duties.

Daniel is Brother Paxton's young assistant in the Northshire Abbey library. He is meant to organize books and count the collection, though his thoughts often turn to tradeskills and professions across Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: Why are books missing from Northshire Abbey?
faq.answer: Brother Paxton says books have gone missing but gives no reason. He asks Daniel to count the collection and find out how many are gone.
Daniel can be found inside Northshire Abbey, among the shelves and desks of the abbey library.

faq.q: Why does Paxton call Daniel useless?
faq.answer: Paxton considers Daniel useless because he neglects his library duties. Instead of cataloging and shelving books, Daniel spends his hours daydreaming and talking about practical tradeskills.

faq.q: What tradeskills is Daniel interested in?
faq.answer: Daniel is fascinated by crafts practiced throughout Elwynn Forest, including blacksmithing, leatherworking, tailoring, and herbal craft. He prefers hands-on work to dusty tomes.

angles.text: As a young human beginning service at Northshire Abbey, you may know the struggle to balance monastic study with practical village life.
As a priest studying Northshire's sacred archives, you rely on order in the library to preserve holy scriptures and Church traditions.
